TrackedDevice.title: TrackedDevice
TrackedDevice.description: Represents a monitored Android device with live GPS coordinates, telemetry, and theft-alert status.

deviceName.description: Display name of the tracked device.

isTracking.description: Whether the foreground GPS streaming service is currently active.

status.description: Current protection state of the device.

accuracyMeters.description: Estimated horizontal GPS accuracy radius in meters.

speedMps.description: Current movement speed in meters per second.

altitudeMeters.description: Altitude above sea level in meters.

isCharging.description: Whether the device is connected to power.

updateIntervalSec.description: Requested location sync interval in seconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device was registered (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest telemetry or settings update (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LocationPing.title: LocationPing
LocationPing.description: Immutable GPS breadcrumb recorded along a device's movement trail.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when ping was recorded (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: User-owned devices streaming live GPS coordinates and telemetry.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}/pings.description: Append-only location trail history for a specific user device.
